# Copilot Instructions — Full-Stack FastAPI + React

## Stack

- **Backend**: Python 3.10+, FastAPI, SQLModel, Alembic, PostgreSQL, `uv` (package manager), OpenAI SDK, MinIO.
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Router (file-based), TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui (Radix), react-hook-form + zod, Biome (linter/formatter), Vite.
- **Linting/typing**: `ruff` (format + lint), `mypy --strict`, Biome.

## Repository Layout

```
backend/app/
  api/routes/     ← FastAPI route handlers only (thin)
  services/       ← business logic
  crud/           ← database queries
  models/         ← SQLModel table models
  schemas/        ← Pydantic request/response shapes
  core/           ← config, logging, security, database
  exceptions/     ← custom exception classes (use these, not bare HTTPException in services)
  middleware/
  alembic/versions/  ← GENERATED by alembic, never edit manually

frontend/src/
  routes/         ← TanStack Router file-based routes
  lib/services/   ← all API service functions (canonical location)
  lib/api-client.ts  ← axios instance with auth interceptor (use this)
  components/ui/  ← shadcn/ui components (DO NOT edit)
  hooks/
  components/
```

## Commands

| Task | Command |
|---|---|
| Backend dev | `uv run fastapi dev` |
| Backend test | `uv run pytest` |
| Backend lint | `uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format .` |
| Backend types | `uv run mypy app` |
| Frontend dev | `npm run dev` |
| Frontend lint | `npm run lint` |
| Frontend build | `npm run build` |
| DB migration | `uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m "description"` |

## DO NOT Edit These Files

- `frontend/src/routeTree.gen.ts` — auto-generated by TanStack Router
- `frontend/src/client/**` — auto-generated API client
- `frontend/src/components/ui/**` — shadcn/ui, update via CLI only
- `backend/app/alembic/versions/*.py` (existing ones) — never modify past migrations

## Rules for Working With This Codebase

1. **Follow existing patterns**: Before writing new code, read a similar existing file and match its style exactly. Do not invent new patterns.
2. **One layer at a time**: Backend changes flow `models` → `schemas` → `crud` → `services` → `api/routes`. Do not skip layers.
3. **No new dependencies without confirmation**: Do not add packages not already in `pyproject.toml` or `package.json`.
4. **Small focused edits**: Edit only the files required. Do not refactor surrounding code unless asked.
5. **Use custom exceptions**: In services and routes, raise from `app.exceptions` (e.g. `NotFoundException`, `RateLimitException`), not bare `HTTPException`.
6. **Use the logger**: `from app.core.logging import get_logger; logger = get_logger(__name__)`. Never use `print()`.

## Verification Checklist (run before declaring done)

```bash
# Backend
cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy app && uv run pytest

# Frontend
cd frontend && npm run lint && npm run build
```

If any command fails, fix the errors before finishing.
